title: Glowing hot air balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='30' ry='34' fill='#FF6B6B'/>

  <path d='M50 4 Q50 4 50 4 Q38 10 30 28 Q24 42 26 62 L50 62 Z' fill='#FFD93D'/>

  <path d='M50 4 Q48 8 44 26 Q40 42 42 62 L50 62 Z' fill='#FFEAA7'/>
  <path d='M50 4 Q52 8 56 26 Q60 42 58 62 L50 62 Z' fill='#FFEAA7'/>

  <path d='M26 62 Q38 72 50 72 Q62 72 74 62 Q70 50 50 48 Q30 50 26 62 Z' fill='#FFB347'/>

  <path d='M38 78 L62 78 L60 88 L40 88 Z' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <path d='M38 78 L62 78 L61 82 L39 82 Z' fill='#D4842A'/>
  <!-- Basket weave lines -->
  <line x1='39' y1='84' x2='61' y2='84' stroke='#8B4513' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='78' x2='50' y2='88' stroke='#8B4513' stroke-width='1'/>
